patthana20.9:1.1: Nasaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ.
patthana20.9:2.1: Naaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana20.9:3.1: Nasaraṇañca naaraṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ.
patthana20.9:4.1: Hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve…pe… avigate pañca.
patthana20.9:5.1: Nasaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā. Naaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā (saṃkhittaṃ).
patthana20.9:6.1: Nahetuyā dve, naārammaṇe tīṇi…pe… novigate tīṇi.
patthana20.9:8.1: Nasaraṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. (1)
patthana20.9:9.1: Naaraṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Naaraṇo dhammo saraṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Naaraṇo dhammo saraṇassa ca araṇassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. (3)
patthana20.9:10.1: Nasaraṇo dhammo saraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Nasaraṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Dve.
patthana20.9:11.1: Naaraṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Naaraṇo dhammo saraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Dve.
patthana20.9:12.1: Hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe cattāri…pe… avigate satta.
patthana20.9:13.1: Paccanīyuddhāro Nasaraṇo dhammo saraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo, upanissayapaccayena paccayo, purejātapaccayena paccayo (saṃkhittaṃ).
patthana20.9:14.1: Nahetuyā satta, naārammaṇe satta…pe… noavigate cattāri.
patthana20.9:15.1: (Yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomampi paccanīyampi anulomapaccanīyampi paccanīyānulomampi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.) Dhammapaccanīyānulome dukapaṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
